title: Paul McCartney's flaming pie dream and the Beatles' name

tellings.quote: I think Paul McCartney one of the Beatles had a dream about a flaming pie,

plain: Paul McCartney of the Beatles is said to have had a dream about a flaming pie, a dream the story links to the band's name. Michels brings it up in an episode about a man who is said to attract UFOs, and he hedges it himself: "I think Paul McCartney one of the Beatles had a dream about a flaming pie." He offers it as a passing aside about visions in the sky, without a source.
